                .then().extract().path("openapi");

@BeforeAll
static void startServer() throws Exception{
        port = freePort();

                .openAPI(new OpenAPI().info(new Info().title("Test API").version("1.0.0")))
                .resourceClasses(Collections.singleton(HelloResource.class.getName()));

        IsolatedAcceptHeaderResource resource = new IsolatedAcceptHeaderResource();
        resource.setOpenApiConfiguration(swaggerConfig);

        ResourceConfig appConfig = new ResourceConfig();
        appConfig.register(resource);
        appConfig.register(HelloResource.class);

        server = GrizzlyHttpServerFactory.createHttpServer(
                URI.create("http://localhost:" + port + "/"), appConfig);

        spec = RestAssured.given().baseUri("http://localhost").port(port);
    }
/**************TEST SETUP END*************/
/**************TEST METHOD BEGIN*************/
@Test
@SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
void jsonAndYamlAcceptContainSamePaths(){
        String jsonPathsStr = given(spec)
                .header("Accept", "application/json")
                .when().get("/openapi")
                .then().extract().path("paths.keySet().toString()");

        String yamlBody = given(spec)
                .header("Accept", "application/yaml")
                .when().get("/openapi")
                .then().extract().body().asString();

        Yaml yaml = new Yaml();
        Map<String, Object> yamlSpec = yaml.load(yamlBody);
        Map<String, Object> yamlPaths = (Map<String, Object>) yamlSpec.get("paths");

        for (String pathKey : yamlPaths.keySet()) {
            assertTrue(jsonPathsStr.contains(pathKey),
                    "JSON spec missing path '" + pathKey + "' present in YAML spec");
        }
    }
/**************TEST METHOD END*************/
/**************TEST TEARDOWN BEGIN*************/
@AfterAll
static void stopServer(){
        if (server != null) {
            server.shutdownNow();
        }
    }
/**************TEST TEARDOWN END*************/

@BeforeAll
static void startServer() throws Exception{
        port = freePort();

        SwaggerConfiguration swaggerConfig = new SwaggerConfiguration()
                .openAPI(new OpenAPI().info(new Info().title("Test API").version("1.0.0")))
                .resourceClasses(Collections.singleton(HelloResource.class.getName()));

        IsolatedOpenApiResource resource = new IsolatedOpenApiResource();
        resource.setOpenApiConfiguration(swaggerConfig);

        ResourceConfig appConfig = new ResourceConfig();
        appConfig.register(resource);
        appConfig.register(HelloResource.class);

        server = GrizzlyHttpServerFactory.createHttpServer(
                URI.create("http://localhost:" + port + "/"), appConfig);

        spec = RestAssured.given().baseUri("http://localhost").port(port);
    }
/**************TEST SETUP END*************/
/**************TEST METHOD BEGIN*************/
@Test
void get_withXmlExtension_returns404(){
        given(spec)
                .when().get("/openapi.xml")
                .then().statusCode(404);
    }
/**************TEST METHOD END*************/
/**************TEST TEARDOWN BEGIN*************/
@AfterAll
static void stopServer(){
        if (server != null) {
            server.shutdownNow();
        }
    }

@BeforeAll
static void startServer() throws Exception{
        port = freePort();

        SwaggerConfiguration swaggerConfig = new SwaggerConfiguration()
                .openAPI(new OpenAPI().info(new Info().title("Test API").version("1.0.0")))
                .resourceClasses(Collections.singleton(HelloResource.class.getName()));

        IsolatedOpenApiResource resource = new IsolatedOpenApiResource();
        resource.setOpenApiConfiguration(swaggerConfig);

        ResourceConfig appConfig = new ResourceConfig();
        appConfig.register(resource);
        appConfig.register(HelloResource.class);

        server = GrizzlyHttpServerFactory.createHttpServer(
                URI.create("http://localhost:" + port + "/"), appConfig);

        spec = RestAssured.given().baseUri("http://localhost").port(port);
    }
/**************TEST SETUP END*************/
/**************TEST METHOD BEGIN*************/
@Test
void getOpenApiJson_specDoesNotContainOpenApiEndpointItself(){
        String body = given(spec)
                .when().get("/openapi.json")
                .then()
                .statusCode(200)
                .extract().body().asString();

        // The /openapi.{type} path should NOT appear in the spec (hidden=true)
        assertTrue(!body.contains("\"/openapi."),
                "Generated spec should not expose the OpenAPI endpoint itself");
    }
/**************TEST METHOD END*************/
/**************TEST TEARDOWN BEGIN*************/
@AfterAll
static void stopServer(){
        if (server != null) {
            server.shutdownNow();
        }
    }

- Data loading means creating, inserting, saving, stubbing, or provisioning state that the test later relies on.
- Data cleanup means deleting, clearing, truncating, resetting, rolling back, expiring, or restoring state.
- Cleanup remains cleanup even when it happens before the test method, such as clearing tables in a fixture to start from an empty database.

Primary data manipulation rule:

Preparation vs behavior under test:
- data_load_* and data_cleanup_* describe data preparation/reset done so the test can exercise the behavior under test.
- Do NOT classify the application action being tested as data loading or cleanup just because it creates, updates, or deletes persistent state.
- For example, if the test calls an API or service and then asserts that a row was created/deleted, that API/service call is the behavior under test, not data loading/cleanup.

Configuration/state distinction:
